name: Clamlette Surprise
summary: Dirge Quikcleave wants supplies for his clamlette, a new culinary creation. In return, he offers to teach you exotic cuisine and prepare a couple for you.

sections.title: A New Recipe
sections.body: Dirge Quikcleave is ready to show you how he makes his clamlette surprise. He needs giant eggs, zesty clam meat, and Alterac Swiss before he can begin. Gather the ingredients he asks for, and Dirge will teach you about exotic cuisine while preparing the dish.

faq.answer: A clamlette is Dirge Quikcleave's latest culinary creation, made with giant eggs, zesty clam meat, and Alterac Swiss.

faq.q: Who is asking for the ingredients?
faq.answer: Dirge Quikcleave wants the ingredients for his clamlette surprise.
Dirge needs giant eggs, zesty clam meat, and Alterac Swiss.

faq.q: Where can I find the giant eggs?
faq.answer: The giant eggs can come from rocs wandering Tanaris or other large birds.

faq.q: Where does the zesty clam meat come from?
faq.answer: Zesty clam meat can be found in clams.

faq.q: Where can I get Alterac Swiss?
faq.answer: Dirge says to get Alterac Swiss from a cheesery.

faq.q: What does Dirge offer in return?
faq.answer: Dirge offers to teach you the finer points of exotic cuisine and prepare a couple of clamblettes for you.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn the finer points of exotic cuisine from Dirge Quikcleave.
